paragraphs.text: Third-year undergraduate student of Data Science at Telkom University specializing in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Computer Vision. Currently serving as a Teaching Assistant for the Sistem Cerdas course, demonstrating strong academic leadership, excellent attention to detail, and a solid foundation in intelligent systems.

Proficient in Python, C++, and SQL with hands-on experience building end-to-end ML pipelines using MLflow and Docker. Proven track record in data science competitions, including securing 3rd Place in the Data Mining Division at ADIKARA 2025. A collaborative team player dedicated to delivering accurate data insights and impactful predictive analytics solutions.

highlights.text: Award-winning data mining competitor (3rd Place ADIKARA 2025)
Expertise in NLP, Computer Vision, and end-to-end ML pipelines
Academic leadership as a Teaching Assistant (Sistem Cerdas)

projects.title: Fossil — Water Potability Prediction
projects.shortDescription: Streamlit app that predicts whether a water sample is safe to drink
projects.description: A Streamlit app that predicts water potability from nine chemical and physical parameters — pH, sulfate, organic carbon and the rest. An MLPClassifier neural network trained on the Kaggle Water Potability dataset backs the call. Built as the GDGoC Telkom University final project.
features: Potability prediction from nine water quality parameters
Interactive parameter input in the browser
MLPClassifier with (100, 50) hidden layers, ReLU and Adam
Exploratory charts of the underlying dataset
Deployed on Streamlit Cloud, no install needed
highlights: Trained on 3,276 water samples from the Kaggle Water Potability dataset
Neural network tuned to (100, 50) hidden layers over 500 iterations
Published as a public Streamlit Cloud app

projects.title: COPPA Risk Prediction Model
projects.shortDescription: XGBoost model that flags mobile apps at risk of COPPA violations
projects.description: An XGBoost classifier that flags mobile apps likely to violate COPPA, the US children's privacy law. The pipeline repairs malformed download ranges and obfuscated country names, groups rare categories, then upsamples the minority class before training. Built solo for the FIND IT! 2025 competition at UGM.
features: Cleaning of malformed download ranges and obfuscated country names
Rare-category grouping and label encoding of categorical fields
Minority-class upsampling to counter a 9:1 imbalance
Probability calibration with CalibratedClassifierCV
Evaluation by ROC-AUC, confusion matrix and classification report
highlights: ROC-AUC of 0.906 on the held-out split
Trained on 7,000 labelled mobile applications
0.89 recall on the at-risk class despite heavy imbalance

projects.title: Crowd Counting with CSRNet
projects.shortDescription: Deep learning crowd density estimation from CCTV imagery
projects.description: An Improved CSRNet in PyTorch that sizes a crowd by predicting a density map rather than counting heads. A VGG-16 frontend feeds a multi-branch dilated backend, so sparse walkways and packed squares both stay accurate. Built for the Hology competition's festival monitoring brief.
features: Density-map estimation with adaptive Gaussian kernels
VGG-16 frontend pre-trained on ImageNet
Multi-branch dilated backend for multi-scale context
Multi-scale and multi-crop augmentation
Checkpointing every 2 epochs, best model chosen by validation MAE
highlights: Improved CSRNet trained for 100 epochs on festival CCTV imagery
Multi-branch backend captures density across several scales
Aimed at overcrowding alerts and evacuation-route planning

projects.title: Pacific Data Viz Challenge — Climate & Disasters
projects.shortDescription: Interactive dashboard on Pacific climate change and disaster patterns
projects.description: An interactive Streamlit dashboard on climate change and disasters across Pacific Island nations, built from Pacific Data Hub open data. Plotly maps and charts let you filter by country and period to trace disaster frequency and climate risk over time.
features: Interactive maps of disaster events by Pacific region
Time-series exploration of climate and disaster indicators
Filtering by country, indicator and period
Comparative charts across regions
Responsive dashboard layout
highlights: Entry to the Pacific Dataviz Challenge
Built entirely on open data from the Pacific Data Hub
Published as a live Streamlit dashboard

projects.title: AstroClassify — Stellar Classification
projects.shortDescription: ML tool that classifies celestial objects from SDSS spectral data
projects.description: A Streamlit tool that sorts celestial objects into galaxy, star or quasar from SDSS spectral measurements. Upload a CSV and it preprocesses the data, runs your pick of Random Forest, XGBoost or LightGBM, then shows the confusion matrix and exports the predictions.
features: CSV upload of astronomical observation data
Automatic preprocessing pipeline
Choice of Random Forest, XGBoost or LightGBM at runtime
Confusion matrices and classification reports per model
Export of prediction results
highlights: Three-class classification of GALAXY, STAR and QSO from SDSS data
Three tuned models shipped with saved weights and evaluation reports
Modular app split into preprocessing, model selection and export modules

projects.title: GenZ Financial Literacy Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: Survey analytics dashboard on Gen Z financial literacy in Indonesia
projects.description: A React and TypeScript dashboard analysing financial literacy, behaviour and well-being among Indonesian Gen Z. Four pages break the survey down by knowledge, digital literacy, behaviour, decision-making and well-being — all filterable across 38 provinces, education level, income and age.
features: Four analysis pages: overview, literacy, behaviour and regional
Filtering by province, education, income and age group
KPI cards, bar charts, scatter plots, radar charts and heatmaps
CSV export of the filtered survey, profile and regional datasets
highlights: Five literacy dimensions analysed across 38 Indonesian provinces
Question-level heatmaps expose where understanding actually breaks down
Aimed at researchers, policymakers and financial-inclusion NGOs

projects.title: Smart Face Anti-Spoofing
projects.shortDescription: Vision model separating real faces from six presentation-attack types
projects.description: A face anti-spoofing classifier that tells a genuine face from six presentation attacks — printed photos, screen replays, masks, mannequins and unknown methods. A DINOv3-ConvNeXt backbone is fine-tuned on YOLO-cropped faces with degradation-heavy augmentation. Competition solution for Find IT! UGM 2026.
features: Six-class classification across real faces and five spoof types
DINOv3-ConvNeXt-Large backbone fine-tuned on paired cropped and full-face images
Augmentation simulating JPEG compression, low resolution, blur and noise
Stratified 80/20 split with early stopping on macro F1
highlights: Best validation macro F1 of 0.97 across six attack classes
Built on the DINOv3 vision foundation model rather than a scratch CNN
Competition solution for Find IT! UGM 2026

projects.title: NutriGinjal — CKD Nutrition App
projects.shortDescription: Flutter health app pairing an AI nutrition assistant with CKD risk prediction
projects.description: A Flutter app for people managing chronic kidney disease. It pairs a Gemini-powered nutrition assistant that answers diet questions against the patient's own restrictions with a risk engine scoring CKD progression from 24 clinical lab parameters, all on a Supabase backend.
features: NutriSnap AI chat: a Gemini nutrition assistant aware of the patient's restrictions and history
Risk engine scoring CKD progression from 24 laboratory parameters
Lab Vault storing and charting past lab results
Supabase backend with role-separated patient and clinician access
highlights: Telkom University capstone joining generative AI and a trained risk model in one app
Handles the protein, potassium and phosphorus limits that make CKD diets hard
Distributed as an installable Android APK

projects.title: WhatsApp AI Assistant Bot
projects.shortDescription: WhatsApp bot that routes messages by detected intent rather than commands
projects.description: A WhatsApp assistant that reads intent instead of matching commands. A Gemini-backed classifier sorts each message into one of 11+ intents, then the bot answers, edits project records in Google Sheets, or declines based on the sender's role. Chat history and summaries keep it in context.
features: AI intent detection across 11+ intent types
Role-based access control separating admin and user actions
Google Sheets integration for querying and updating project data
Memory system holding chat history, summaries and context
highlights: Intent detection in 200-500 ms, full replies under three seconds
Natural-language routing replaces rigid command syntax
Write operations gated behind an admin allowlist

projects.title: Melodia — Music Streaming App
projects.shortDescription: Full-stack personal music streaming app on React and Spring Boot
projects.description: A personal music streaming web app with a React front end over a Spring Boot API and PostgreSQL. Users register, build a library and playlists, stream tracks and review listening history. Written for an OOP course, so inheritance, encapsulation and interfaces shape the domain model.
features: JWT authentication with user, artist and admin roles
Personal music library and custom playlist management
Streaming player with play, pause, next and previous
Listening history and account settings
OOP domain model across User, Song, Playlist and MusicPlayer
highlights: React and Vite front end against a Spring Boot 3 REST API
Three-role auth model persisted in PostgreSQL
Deployed on Railway

projects.title: AES-256-CBC Encryption Tool
projects.shortDescription: Colab-based file and text encryption using AES-256-CBC with PBKDF2
projects.description: A file and text encryption tool for a data security course. It runs AES-256 in CBC mode with keys derived through PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 at 100,000 iterations, generating a fresh random salt and IV on every operation. Opens straight in Google Colab with nothing to install.
features: Text encryption to JSON and decryption back to plain text
File encryption of any type up to 1 MB, original filename kept in metadata
PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 key derivation over 100,000 iterations
Fresh random 128-bit salt and IV on every encryption
Menu-driven interface, no local setup required
highlights: Random salt and IV per operation, so identical inputs never produce identical ciphertext
100,000 PBKDF2 iterations to make password brute-forcing expensive
Runs one-click in Colab, which removes the usual crypto-library setup

projects.title: Portfolio with React and Vite
projects.shortDescription: The React and Vite version of this portfolio, driven by a single JSON file
projects.description: The React and Vite version of this portfolio: a single-page site where every piece of content comes from one portfolio.json file. Glassmorphism styling, AOS scroll animations and a Swiper project slider, with category filtering and a contact form.
features: All content driven by a single portfolio.json data file
Glassmorphism UI with AOS scroll animations
Swiper-powered project slider with category filtering
Responsive layout from mobile to desktop
Semantic HTML and meta tags for SEO
highlights: One JSON file changes every section, so content edits need no code
Component architecture kept reusable for the later Next.js rebuild
Deployed on Vercel

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.shortDescription: Random Forest churn classifier built for a GDGOC competition
projects.description: A churn classifier built for the GDGOC Telkom University Customer Churn Prediction Challenge. Missing values are filled with KNNImputer and categorical fields label-encoded before a Random Forest is trained, then scored on F1 — which matters more than accuracy on an imbalanced churn label.
features: KNNImputer filling missing numerical values
Label encoding of categorical customer attributes
Random Forest classifier trained on an 80/20 split
F1-score, classification report and confusion matrix evaluation
Predictions exported to CSV for submission
highlights: Submission to the GDGOC Telkom University churn challenge
F1 chosen over accuracy so the imbalanced churn class still counts
KNN-based imputation instead of dropping incomplete customer records

projects.title: Preprocessing Pipeline — Study Group 4
projects.shortDescription: One preprocessing and feature engineering pipeline applied across five datasets
projects.description: A preprocessing and feature engineering exercise for the GDGOC Telkom University study group, run across five unrelated datasets. Each gets the same treatment — profiling, IQR outlier removal, standardisation, one-hot and datetime encoding — the point being a repeatable pipeline rather than one clever model.
features: Profiling of each dataset: schema, descriptive stats, missing values, duplicates
IQR-based outlier removal with before/after boxplots
StandardScaler standardisation of numeric columns
One-hot encoding of categorical columns and datetime parsing
highlights: The same pipeline applied to five separate datasets to prove it generalises
Outliers trimmed with the 1.5×IQR rule and verified visually each time
Covers scaling, encoding and datetime handling end to end

projects.title: Ollama DeepSeek Discord Bot
projects.shortDescription: Discord bot serving a locally hosted DeepSeek model through Ollama
projects.description: A Discord bot that pipes messages to a DeepSeek model running locally through Ollama, so conversations never leave the machine. Token, model and behaviour all come from environment variables, which makes pointing it at a different local model a one-line change.
features: Chat with a locally hosted DeepSeek model from any Discord channel
Ollama runtime integration, no cloud inference
Configuration through environment variables with secrets kept in .env
Extensible base for other custom AI Discord bots
highlights: Inference runs entirely on local hardware, so no prompt data leaves the host
Tokens and configuration stay out of source control via .env
Written as a reusable base for other AI-powered Discord bots

projects.title: Tech Stock EDA — Study Group 3
projects.shortDescription: Exploratory analysis of AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, ASUS and MSI share prices
projects.description: An exploratory analysis of daily share prices for AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, ASUS and MSI, submitted for the GDGOC Telkom University Python-for-ML topic. Correlation matrices, distribution histograms and volume boxplots over 316 trading days show how closely the five tech stocks move together.
features: Correlation matrix across price and volume variables
Histograms of price and volume distributions
Boxplots surfacing outliers in trading volume
Kaggle dataset covering AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, ASUS and MSI
highlights: 316 daily records analysed across five tech-sector stocks
Correlation analysis linking price movement to trading volume
Submitted for the GDGOC Telkom University Python for ML topic

projects.title: TUBES AKA — Iterative vs Recursive Complexity
projects.shortDescription: Benchmarking iterative against recursive search in a song recommender
projects.description: The final project for Analisis Kompleksitas Algoritma. One song-recommendation scoring routine is written twice, iteratively and recursively, then timed against a user set growing from 10 to 300 — plotting how each version's runtime actually scales rather than assuming it.
features: Song scoring by matching favourite song, artist and genres via sequential search
Iterative and recursive implementations of the same routine
Runtime measured as the user set grows from 10 to 300 in steps of 10
Execution-time curves plotted for both variants
Synthetic user and song datasets generated for the benchmark
highlights: Empirical runtime comparison of iterative against recursive search
Benchmarked across 30 dataset sizes from 10 to 300 users
Final project for the Algorithm Complexity Analysis course

projects.title: Text Editor Laba-Laba Sunda
projects.shortDescription: Terminal text editor in C++ with undo/redo and block copy-paste
projects.description: A terminal text editor in C++, built as the Struktur Data final project. Past insert and delete it handles undo/redo, block copy-paste bound to Ctrl+B/G/P, cursor movement in all four directions, and several files open in one session.
features: Insert, delete and edit text blocks
Undo and redo of edits
Block selection, copy and paste via Ctrl+B / Ctrl+G / Ctrl+P
Multi-file management within a single session
Four-direction cursor navigation in the terminal
highlights: Struktur Data final project built by the Laba-Laba Sunda team of three
Undo/redo and block copy-paste built directly on linked lists and stacks
Runs entirely in the terminal with no external dependencies

projects.title: Web Portfolio with Bootstrap 5
projects.shortDescription: The first portfolio iteration — Bootstrap 5 with a glassmorphism look
projects.description: The first version of this portfolio, hand-built on Bootstrap 5 with a glassmorphism look. A dark/light toggle that remembers your choice, a Swiper project slider, AOS scroll animations and lazy-loaded assets across About, Skills, Projects and Contact.
features: Glassmorphism design with backdrop blur
Dark/light theme toggle with the choice persisted
Swiper.js project slider with manual navigation
AOS scroll animations and lazy-loaded images
Mobile-first responsive layout
highlights: First portfolio iteration, later rebuilt in React and then Next.js
Theme choice persisted across visits
Semantic HTML with meta tags and accessible markup

projects.title: Student Academic Performance Prediction
projects.shortDescription: CatBoost model predicting student dropout, enrolment or graduation
projects.description: A CatBoost model predicting whether a university student will drop out, stay enrolled or graduate, on the UCI Predict Students' Dropout dataset. Rare categories are grouped, GDP is adjusted for inflation, and CatBoost handles the twenty-odd categorical features natively.
features: Three-class prediction: dropout, enrolled or graduate
Rare-category grouping driven by a frequency threshold
Inflation-adjusted GDP as an engineered macroeconomic feature
CatBoostClassifier over 1,000 iterations with native categorical handling
Evaluation by classification report and confusion matrix
highlights: Built on the UCI Predict Students' Dropout and Academic Success dataset
CatBoost avoids one-hot blowup across 20+ categorical features
Three notebooks tracing the baseline through to the tuned pipeline

projects.title: Discord Music Bot V2
projects.shortDescription: Discord music bot streaming YouTube audio with full queue control
projects.description: A Discord music bot on Node.js and discord.js v14 that streams YouTube audio through yt-dlp and FFmpeg. Queue management, per-track and whole-queue loops, shuffle, volume, in-Discord search, now-playing embeds, and auto-disconnect once the channel goes quiet.
features: YouTube audio streaming via yt-dlp and FFmpeg
Queue management: view, add, remove, skip, shuffle and clear
Loop modes for a single track or the whole queue
YouTube search from inside Discord with now-playing embeds
Volume control and auto-disconnect when idle
highlights: Complete playback control: play, pause, resume, skip, stop, shuffle and loop
Search and queue tracks without ever leaving Discord
Auto-disconnect on inactivity so idle bots stop holding voice channels

projects.title: Go Library Manager
projects.shortDescription: Console library system in Go handling books, members and loans
projects.description: A console library management system in Go, written for the Algoritma dan Pemrograman course. It catalogues books, registers members, issues and returns loans with automatic due dates and overdue fines, and searches by title, author, ISBN or category.
features: Book cataloguing with add, update, delete and availability tracking
Member registration with status and borrowing history
Borrowing and returns with automatic due dates and fine calculation
Search by title, author, ISBN or category
Reports on active loans, most-borrowed books and member activity
highlights: Course project applying structs, sorting and searching to a real workflow
Automatic due-date tracking with overdue fine calculation
Console interface with formatted reports
